title: Speed of Light in Meters per Second: SI Unit Explanation
snippet: TL;DR: The speed of light in a vacuum is 299,792,458 meters per second (m/s) —the SI unit definition since 1983. This value is exact (not approximate) and ties the meter to the second via light’s speed. Key takeaways: it’s the cosmic speed limit, used to define time/space in physics, and affects GPS, fiber optics, and relativity.
